title: cuspidaria hymenaea
intro: Cuspidaria hymenaea, commonly known as the Coral Tree or Coral Bush, is a flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. It is native to tropical Africa and is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing fever, treating wounds, and alleviating respiratory issues.
